Question: A circle with integer radius \(r\) is centered at \((r,r).\) Distinct line segments of length \(c_i\) connect points \((0,a_i)\) to \((b_i,0)\) for \(1\le i\le14\) and are tangent to the circle, where \(a_i,\) \(b_i,\) and \(c_i\) are all positive integers and \(c_1\le c_2\le\cdots\le c_{14}.\) What is the ratio \(\dfrac{c_{14}}{c_1}\) for the least possible value of \(r?\)
